items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: so we went away, you see, with Chinch and Ella B. Moore, and we traveled throughout the South.

ctx.x: Well, there was Sissle and Blake, as I'm saying, and at that time there was Chinch and Ellerby's More Show. They had a show called Brown Skin Buddies. And they was finishing up their tour. The was finishing entirely

with traveling, I mean you know doing the show throughout the South, and, you know, they was happening having to be standing in the wings watching, you know, especially when someone would stop the show or something, see. And they were looking for talent, I guess.
